caption:
A no-show doesn't just cost the appointment.

It costs the ad spend that generated the lead in the first place.

Most shops send one reminder and hope. Here's the sequence that holds the slot:

72 hours out: confirm or reschedule
24 hours out: the real reminder
2 hours out: the last check before the slot goes to someone else

Studies on automated SMS reminder sequences show no-show reductions in the 30-60% range, depending on how many touches run.

Example workflow, not a specific client result.
